acceptance_scope_note: User narrowed completion to Petals already enabled in Bloom; Pump.fun is excluded from the remaining acceptance scope. The wider source inventory below preserves historical work and is not an enabled-package list.
scope: All route source leaves at pinned default/candidate revisions, grouped by actual authority surface. A route file may be read-only, administrative, or share a handler. Lists do not prove every route executes a decoded transaction; coverage_status applies only to reading_scope, never to effects, identity, settlement or release acceptance. Unknown future targets/assets/layouts remain explicitly unknown.

coverage_status_definitions.independently_read: Broker reconstructs supported actual signing bytes. Does not establish code, state, market/asset identities or effects beyond the stated scope.
coverage_status_definitions.partial: Shared structural readers cover the stated fields; additional semantics/identities remain unresolved.
coverage_status_definitions.api_consent: Consent uses API credentials, not wallet signing.
coverage_status_definitions.not_applicable: No wallet signing/outbox capability at the pinned manifest.

petals.reading_scope: Native/ERC-20 inputs, safe-route receiver and requested output balance-increase checks on all twelve accepted networks. Petal locally prepares same-chain safeRouteSingle/Multi preserving inner bytes; refresh preserves the reviewed calldata floor; settlement uses its actual minimum.
petals.limits: Nested shortcut code/effects, runtime code, fees and cross-chain settlement. The same-chain output check constrains successful execution, not proof of received funds. Unknown token identities stay raw. 140 Petal tests and six private-EVM pinned-contract cases passed; no funded venue or physical owner acceptance.
